snippet.title: Gonggi: Recess - Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Out now in Early Access on Steam (released November 23, 2026)
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5475700/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch-trailer-en

Recess at a 2000s Korean elementary school, five gonggi stones on your desk. Scatter, toss, pick up and catch with the hand you move with the mouse. Play your seatmate or a Steam friend for wrist flicks, or climb Grades 1 to 6. Between rounds, touch 140+ things around school and play with friends.

Made in Korea by a solo developer.

Generative AI was used for writing, translation and music: most of the background music and the trailer music were made with Suno, and the arcade game tunes were composed with Claude. The in-game art was designed by the developer and made with Claude as a coding tool, without image-generation models.
